\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 210-213 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R217-first-pass-words-from-chapters-210-213}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for worship and religion.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a paratha, khichri, halwa, a laddu, pickle
  \item chutney, spice, turmeric, coriander, a lemon
  \item ugly, strong, weak, cheap, hard
  \item necessary, dangerous, safe, sweet, soft
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A paratha? (\textbf{\hi{पराठा}}, \emph{parāṭhā}.) Khichri? (\textbf{\hi{खिचड़ी}}, \emph{khicṛī}.) Halwa? (\textbf{\hi{हलवा}}, \emph{halvā}.) A laddu? (\textbf{\hi{लड्डू}}, \emph{laḍḍū}.) Pickle? (\textbf{\hi{अचार}}, \emph{achār}.) Chutney? (\textbf{\hi{चटनी}}, \emph{caṭnī}.) Spice? (\textbf{\hi{मसाला}}, \emph{masālā}.) Turmeric? (\textbf{\hi{हल्दी}}, \emph{haldī}.) Coriander? (\textbf{\hi{धनिया}}, \emph{dhaniyā}.) A lemon? (\textbf{\hi{नींबू}}, \emph{nī̃bū}.) Ugly? (\textbf{\hi{भद्दा}}, \emph{bhaddā}.) Strong? (\textbf{\hi{मज़बूत}}, \emph{mazbūt}.) Weak? (\textbf{\hi{कमज़ोर}}, \emph{kamzor}.) Cheap? (\textbf{\hi{सस्ता}}, \emph{sastā}.) Hard? (\textbf{\hi{कठिन}}, \emph{kaṭhin}.) Necessary? (\textbf{\hi{ज़रूरी}}, \emph{zarūrī}.) Dangerous? (\textbf{\hi{ख़तरनाक}}, \emph{khatarnāk}.) Safe? (\textbf{\hi{सुरक्षित}}, \emph{surakṣit}.) Sweet? (\textbf{\hi{मीठा}}, \emph{mīṭhā}.) Soft? (\textbf{\hi{नर्म}}, \emph{narm}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 214-217 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R217-second-pass-words-from-chapters-214-217}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for smooth and busy.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item smooth, busy, lazy, honest, true
  \item false, clever, foolish, brave, kind
  \item a peanut, a radish, an aubergine, okra, a papaya
  \item a pomegranate, a guava, a festival, worship, religion
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Smooth? (\textbf{\hi{चिकना}}, \emph{cikanā}.) Busy? (\textbf{\hi{व्यस्त}}, \emph{vyast}.) Lazy? (\textbf{\hi{आलसी}}, \emph{ālsī}.) Honest? (\textbf{\hi{ईमानदार}}, \emph{īmāndār}.) True? (\textbf{\hi{सच्चा}}, \emph{saccā}.) False? (\textbf{\hi{झूठा}}, \emph{jhūṭhā}.) Clever? (\textbf{\hi{बुद्धिमान}}, \emph{buddhimān}.) Foolish? (\textbf{\hi{मूर्ख}}, \emph{mūrkh}.) Brave? (\textbf{\hi{बहादुर}}, \emph{bahādur}.) Kind? (\textbf{\hi{दयालु}}, \emph{dayālu}.) A peanut? (\textbf{\hi{मूँगफली}}, \emph{mū̃gphalī}.) A radish? (\textbf{\hi{मूली}}, \emph{mūlī}.) An aubergine? (\textbf{\hi{बैंगन}}, \emph{bãigan}.) Okra? (\textbf{\hi{भिंडी}}, \emph{bhinḍī}.) A papaya? (\textbf{\hi{पपीता}}, \emph{papītā}.) A pomegranate? (\textbf{\hi{अनार}}, \emph{anār}.) A guava? (\textbf{\hi{अमरूद}}, \emph{amrūd}.) A festival? (\textbf{\hi{त्योहार}}, \emph{tyohār}.) Worship? (\textbf{\hi{पूजा}}, \emph{pūjā}.) Religion? (\textbf{\hi{धर्म}}, \emph{dharm}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
